name: picky-client
description: Pick-driven UI/UX design. Present candidate drafts (시안) as a tournament, round by round, and let the user choose — real rendered React candidates in a dev-only /picky-drafts harness, plus a self-contained, language-neutral UX-writing gate.

interface.shortDescription: Pick-driven UI/UX design — decide a screen's look by choosing between candidate drafts, round by round.
interface.longDescription: picky-client turns UI/UX design into a tournament of candidate drafts (시안). Instead of guessing one design and editing it forever, it renders real React candidates in a dev-only /picky-drafts harness and lets you pick a winner each round; the winner seeds the next round until the design settles. Includes a self-contained, language-neutral UX-writing gate for the words on screen.
